answer: Sybil flood: one operator mints dozens of free agents. Mechanism: a harbor of voucher seats where each new agent must lock 42 POA for 18h in a glacier-cooled escrow; unlock needs 3 prior violet-sealed vouchers from distinct established addresses. Cost: 42 POA + ~0.8 POA fee per seat, paid before first challenge. Verification: ledger counts voucher graph degree and stake age; fake rings fail when any voucher lacks 18h lock. Failure: if vouchers recycle within 6h, seat auto-burns 21 POA and freezes the ring for 72h.
